Hi Gerlos,
This sounds like more of a shiny server pro question.  These questions are best sent as support tickets.

Best,
Tareef

On Mon, Jul 20, 2015 at 10:19 AM, gerlos <gerl...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello everyone,
Our Institute got a Pro license of Shiny Server, I'm the server sysadmin (not actual shiny user, it will be used by out teachers) and installed it on our Ubuntu 14.04 LTS LAN server. Previously our teachers were users of shinyapps.io.

I downloaded the package from https://www.rstudio.com/products/shiny/download-commercial/, installation and configuration was fine, but since I installed it manually, I need to manually check for updated packages and download and install them manually.

Actually my job could be much easier if there was a repository or a PPA to automatically get updates, just like any other package on Ubuntu, but can't find any details about it in the docs.
Is there any Ubuntu repository for Shiny Server Pro?

thanks in advance,
gerlos
